name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; '12' is the chapter ID (chapters 01-30 are meaningful domain IDs), not an address residue (the function is at 0x333f5, unrelated to 12). Dispatch table at 0x51d9d confirms this is the chapter-12 slot (preceded by ch11 @0x33367, followed by ch13 @0x3346b). Name accurately reflects: chapter-12 init handler.
purpose: Chapter 12 (北山道) init/prologue handler: re-inits battle state, loads portrait set 1, plays two cutscenes (events 0x28/0x29) each preceded by a camera pan, clears all facings, then plays a single dialog page (page 0) and pans the camera to char 0. Cutscene-first ordering (unlike the dialog-first chapter-02..11 inits); carries the party over from chapter 11 (no char init).
logic_summary: Flat prologue orchestrator (cyclomatic 1, no branches in source body). Sequence: fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter(); fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(4,4); set data_fd2_chapter_init_phase_flag=1; fd2_load_chapter_portraits_and_dump_tmp(1); clear flag=0; fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x28); fd2_pan_cursor_and_window(0xb,0x28); fd2_cutscene_event_trigger(0x29); fd2_clear_all_chars_facing(); fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text,0,0xa0000,0x140,0xcd,0x4c,0x4a,0x13,1); fd2_pan_cursor_to_char(0). Note the clear-facing precedes the (single) dialog page here. In the binary the page-0 dialog call + final pan are emitted as a tail-JMP from this handler's own dialog-arg push (0x3344D) into shared epilogue 0x33206; the C is the functionally-equivalent (Layer 2) straight-line form. The leading __CHK(0x28) in the decompile is the Watcom-injected stack-size probe, not part of the source body.

returns.semantics: No return value; dispatched handler invoked via the chapter dispatch table at 0x51d9d.

reads_globals: data_fd2_current_chapter_text (0x53A79) — passed to fd2_display_dialog_scene as the chapter text buffer for the page-0 dialog.
writes_globals: data_fd2_chapter_init_phase_flag (0x53AFA) — set to 1 around the portrait load (set 1) at 0x33410, cleared to 0 at 0x33421; read by fd2_init_runtime_char_for_battle as a phase guard.
